page.notes: Long s is rendered as s and the footnote text was printed in small type; several reference marks (letters in the text and in the margin) are only approximately matched and may be misassigned: marks c, e, g, h, i, k, l, m. The opening word is partly obscured and is given as [?]nia. The paragraph "138" note and the foot lines at the bottom are fragmentary and partly doubtful. The word "postu-lando" hyphenation and "pignorati-tia" are uncertain. The lines "feccione" contain a Cyrillic look-alike that should be read as "fessione"/"fessione"; please verify. Footnote and margin symbols at the bottom right of the scan (stray marks) are not transcribed.
